movelist.name: Hidden Power
movelist.effect: When a Pokémon first obtains the Move Hidden Power, roll 1d20. Hidden Power’s Elemental Type will be changed from Normal to Bug on a result of 1; Dark on 2; Dragon on 3; Electric on 4; Fairy on 5; Fighting on 6; Fire on 7; Flying on 8; Ghost on 9; Grass on 10; Ground on 11; Ice on 12; Normal on 13; Poison on 14; Psychic on 15; Rock on 16; Steel on 17; Water on 18; and on 19 or 20, reroll until you roll another number. This effect is permanent –if Hidden Power is forgotten and relearned, the chosen Type remains the same.

movelist.name: Water Pulse
movelist.effect: Water Pulse Confuses the target on 17+.

movelist.name: Mud Bomb
movelist.effect: The target’s Accuracy is lowered by -1 on 16+.

movelist.name: Mud-Slap
movelist.effect: The target’s Accuracy is lowered by -1.

movelist.name: Harden
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Mud Sport
movelist.effect: All targets in the burst, including the user, gain a Coat which grants them 1 Step of Resistance to Electric Type Moves. After a target has been hit by a damaging Electric Type Move, the coat is removed.

abilities.name: Storm Drain
abilities.effect: The Move is turned into a 1-Target Move and is re-directed at the user without fail, and cannot miss. This negates Lock-On or Mind Reader.  the user’s Special Attack is then raised by +1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Sticky Hold
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s held items cannot be stolen, switched, destroyed or dropped.
